reason: A DSH web interface plugin for browsing, searching, ranking, inspecting, and installing other plugins from local and GitHub-based sources.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供插件榜单、搜索、权限检测和一键安装功能。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH web interface for browsing, searching, checking access to, and installing plugins from ranked listings.

capabilities: Adds a sidebar button and popup interface to browse and search plugin rankings
Fetches public GitHub plugin information and checks repository access permissions
Clones repositories over HTTPS or SSH and installs plugin files into DSH locations
Persists installation and permission status and displays real-time installation logs
